citation.title: Effects of Cannabidiol on Submaximal and Incremental Running in Trained Runners: A Randomised, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled, Crossover, Dose-Ranging Trial

reported.what: Placebo-arm heart rate at 20, 40 and 60 min of the 60-min run (RUN 1), median [IQR]; the run's own VO2 (24, 37, 50 min) is also median [IQR]
Placebo-arm capillary blood glucose at the end of RUN 1, mean ± SD (breakfast eaten before treatment is printed with carbohydrate and protein but no fat)
Placebo-arm capillary blood glucose at the end of RUN 2, mean ± SD
Peak heart rate at the end of the incremental run to exhaustion (RUN 2), placebo, mean ± SD
Standardised breakfast eaten before treatment: energy, carbohydrate and protein printed, fat not

detail: Most of the placebo-arm numbers the model could take (heart rate and VO2 of the 60-min run, lactate) are printed as median [IQR], while the mean ± SD rows are blocked by a breakfast whose fat is not printed (glucose) or by a ramp to exhaustion beyond the activity scale (peak heart rate); no resting or fasting mean ± SD value is in the paper's text or tables.
